decision_record.calculation: Verified on the batch-3 fixture chain via B3.entry_view_for('aster_rec_vwap20_long_touch_b'): treatment intent order_type=limit with enhance_exp spread_saved > 0 vs the control crossed price; switch OFF returns order_type=market with no enhance_exp (tests/test_harden_edge_batch11_blockers.py TestLongTouchBMidLimitVerified). This sleeve was NOT in batch 10's test census (its B3_IDS stopped at long_touch_a); batch 11 closes that gap.
decision_record.comparison: Baseline: market package orders priced for risk at the crossed executable side but EXECUTED with no price instruction. Comparator: identical signal/quotes, limit at the package mid of the same already-fetched, freshness-gated (10s OPRA, 2s leg-sync) quotes.
decision_record.experiment: Batch-11 blockers drive entry for this exact sleeve id both ways; rejection rule: limit not strictly inside the crossed package price, or any enhance_exp record when the switch is OFF.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution (spread crossing): the batch-3 engine already fetches and freshness-gates both legs' quotes to price the package; the pre-change intent discarded that price at execution time.
decision_record.transfer: The VWAP20 long recovery book's surplus is a short-horizon dip capture sized by a debit budget; paying the full ask (entry) and taking the full bid (exit) via market orders donates the quoted spread twice per round trip.

disposition: ENHANCED (batch-10 treatment, batch-11 verified for this sleeve): entry/exit limit at package mid
